parameters.content:
## Schema probe - run once, then discard

The CS performance table CANNOT produce an everyone-level roster. Proven on snapshot 2026-09-10: emid is NULL across all 128,694 'Day' rows, and only 39 of 20,599 active Frontline rows carry any usable identity. employee, name and site are empty too. No filter change makes agents appear.

This probe reads the COLUMN LISTS of the two candidate sources that can. It is free - INFORMATION_SCHEMA is metadata, it scans no table data - and it writes NOTHING to your Google Sheet, so your current roster is untouched.

### How to use
1. Import, select the BigQuery credential on both BigQuery nodes.
2. Click Run Refresh Manually.
3. Open the LAST node, Code - Build Schema Report, and copy the `report` value.
4. Paste it back.

Both BigQuery nodes are set to continue on error, so if one view is inaccessible the probe still reports on the other rather than failing.

### Why a probe instead of just writing the query
The documented column list for the master reporting view covers identity and workgroup fields but not its DATE column or its MANAGER columns. Guessing a date column wrong on an agent/day view either errors or triggers a full scan of a very large table. One free metadata query removes that risk entirely.
